explanation:
1. Drizzle-orm is the clear leader and the fastest grower. It accounts for 51.9% of the selection's downloads, with 112,088,633 total and 4,003,165 per day on average, and its change of +22.7% is the highest of the three. Prisma sits at 37.1% of the selection, and TypeORM at 10.9%.

2. Drizzle-orm is about 1.4 times as large as Prisma by total downloads, using the listed totals. TypeORM is the slowest grower at +9.2%, while Prisma grew +15.8%.

3. Weekend traffic is a clear pattern. Prisma's weekend days run at 59% of weekday volume (41% lower), drizzle-orm at 62.4% (37.6% lower), and TypeORM at 34.8% (65.2% lower). TypeORM's weekday-heavy profile suggests its installs are more tied to work-week development and CI, though this is only a possibility.

4. Drizzle-orm's volume is the most concentrated in unusual days. The detector found 5 unusual days for it, 2 for TypeORM, and 1 for Prisma, which makes drizzle-orm's recent growth worth watching for whether it is sustained or driven by bursts.

Spikes: The largest spikes are drizzle-orm on 2026-09-28 (4,812,017 downloads against a usual 3,159,025, +52%), drizzle-orm on 2026-09-29 (4,971,534 downloads, +45%), and drizzle-orm on 2026-10-05 (4,932,561 downloads, +54%). Each of these has no stable release listed in the 3 days before, so no release was found nearby and no reason is assumed. A further 5 unusual days are found, including TypeORM and Prisma spikes on 2026-09-26 and 2026-09-28. The release history for the listed spikes is not available here, so no release is attributed to any spike.
